meta.sample: Adults aged 20-59 who answered the NHANES marijuana question (DUQ200), MEC-examined, NHANES 2005-2018 public files
meta.design: Weights WTMEC2YR/7 (pooled 2005-2018), strata SDMVSTRA, PSU SDMVPSU, Taylor linearization; design built on the full pooled sample and restricted with subset()
meta.reliability: Korn-Graubard 95% CIs; NCHS Data Presentation Standards for Proportions (Parker et al. 2017) applied

mj_regular.label: Regular cannabis use (monthly for ≥1 year), ever

mj_daily.label: Used cannabis on 20–30 of past 30 days

couse_ever.label: Ever used both cannabis and cigarettes

couse_current.label: Current co-use (cannabis past 30 days + current smoking)

cancer_excl_skin.label: Ever told had cancer, excluding non-melanoma skin

cancer_excl_cervical.label: Ever told had cancer, excluding cervical
